These saved feeds let the self-tests run without the internet.

Headlines, links and publication dates are real: collected on 2 November 2026 from Gadgets 360 and 91mobiles,
plus three cross-outlet articles found by web search (their times are rounded to midday on the publication day).
Summaries are paraphrased. They keep the facts and the wording patterns the rules must handle, such as
"under Rs 20,000", "worth Rs. 799", "around Rs 19,000" and a rival product's price in the same article.
